ir.name: all_pairs_safe_cast_002
ir.intuition: Creates pairwise preferences for every strict objective improvement (lower is better) within each batch item, optionally filtering out small objective gaps and globally capping to the largest improvements by gap size.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    # Read extras without using Python builtins like int()/float(); treat as already numeric.
    max_pairs = extra.get('max_pairs', 128)
    gap_threshold = extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0)

    # objective: [B, K], lower is better
    obj_i = objective[:, :, None]
    obj_j = objective[:, None, :]

    # Positive gap means i is better than j by that amount (j - i)
    gaps = obj_j - obj_i
    mask = gaps > gap_threshold
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Ensure int64 indices
    b_idx = b_idx.to(torch.int64)
    winner_idx = winner_idx.to(torch.int64)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.to(torch.int64)

    # Optional global cap by strongest gaps
    if max_pairs is not None and max_pairs > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        scores = gaps[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
        topk = scores.topk(k=max_pairs, largest=True).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_safe_cast', 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'gap_threshold': gap_threshold},
    )

ir.name: anchor_extremes_simple_002
ir.intuition: Build one deterministic preference per batch item by comparing the lowest-objective candidate (winner) against the highest-objective candidate (loser); if all objectives tie (same index), emit no pair for that item to avoid self-comparisons.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    B, K = objective.shape

    device = objective.device

    # If there is only one candidate per instance, no valid pairwise preferences exist.
    if K < 2:
        b_idx = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.int64)
        w_idx = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.int64)
        l_idx = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.int64)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_extremes_simple'})

    # lower_is_better
    best_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1).to(torch.int64)
    worst_idx = objective.argmax(dim=1).to(torch.int64)

    b = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)

    # One comparison per instance: best vs worst.
    b_idx = b
    winner_idx = best_idx
    loser_idx = worst_idx

    # Drop self-pairs (can happen when all objectives tie so best==worst).
    keep = winner_idx != loser_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[keep]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[keep]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_extremes_simple'})

ir.name: builder_anchor_vs_worst_001_fix
ir.intuition: For each batch instance, create exactly one pair by selecting the lowest-objective completion as the winner and the highest-objective completion as the loser, ensuring full per-instance coverage and stable, deterministic comparisons even when K==1.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Pick best (lowest objective) vs worst (highest objective) per instance.
    best_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # [B]
    worst_idx = objective.argmax(dim=1)  # [B]

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).to(torch.long)
    winner_idx = best_idx.to(torch.long)
    loser_idx = worst_idx.to(torch.long)

    # If only one completion exists, self-pair to keep shapes valid.
    if K <= 1:
        loser_idx = winner_idx

    b_idx = b_idx.reshape(-1)
    winner_idx = winner_idx.reshape(-1)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.reshape(-1)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_worst'}
    )

ir.name: anchor_best_worst_v2
ir.intuition: For each batch instance, deterministically select the lowest-objective candidate as the winner and the highest-objective candidate as the loser, yielding exactly one stable best-vs-worst preference pair per instance with full coverage.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # One deterministic pair per instance: best (min objective) vs worst (max objective).
    sort_idx = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1)  # ascending
    winner_idx = sort_idx[:, 0].to(dtype=torch.long).reshape(-1)
    loser_idx = sort_idx[:, -1].to(dtype=torch.long).reshape(-1)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long).reshape(-1)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={'builder': 'anchor_best_worst_v2', 'pairs_per_instance': 1}
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 147))
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        perm = torch.randperm(b_idx.numel(), device=b_idx.device)[:max_pairs]
        b_idx = b_idx[perm]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[perm]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[perm]
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'sampled_pairs', 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

ir.name: builder_anchor_best_000
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    best = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    all_idx = torch.arange(objective.shape[1], device=objective.device)[None, :].expand_as(objective)
    b_idx = torch.arange(objective.shape[0], device=objective.device)[:, None].expand_as(all_idx)
    winner_idx = best.expand_as(all_idx)
    loser_idx = all_idx
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx
    b = b_idx[mask]
    w = winner_idx[mask]
    l = loser_idx[mask]
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b, w, l), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_best'})
